title: Unveiling the Deficiencies of Pre-trained Text-and-Layout Models in Real-world Visually-rich Document Information Extraction

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on the newly proposed EC-FUNSD dataset, which decouples layout and entity annotations, and comparing the results to the original FUNSD dataset to quantify the models' reliance on false input-label layout correlations.

Testing the consistency of model performance by comparing the overall recall on the entire set of document entities against the recall on a specifically challenging subset of 'complex entities' (e.g., entities that span multiple rows and columns or overlap with other regions).
